destinations.name: Disneyland Paris
destinations.blurb: The closest Disney resort to our home port, and where our Davy Crockett Ranch stay took place.
destinations._source: reviews.json (Davy Crockett Ranch) and food.json entries located at Disneyland Paris

destinations.name: Walt Disney World
destinations.blurb: Across the Atlantic to Florida. Our crew photo was taken here, in front of Cinderella Castle at Magic Kingdom, and our dining note from Be Our Guest Restaurant comes from here too.

photo.alt: The five of us standing arm in arm in front of Cinderella Castle at Magic Kingdom

destinations._source: Confirmed by the crew: the group photo was taken at Walt Disney World. The Be Our Guest entry in food.json (Fantasyland) is from here as well.

destinations.name: Mediterranean Cruise
destinations.blurb: A cruise across the Mediterranean Sea, setting sail from Barcelona. The pin marks the port we left from.
destinations._source: Confirmed by the crew: a Mediterranean cruise departing from Barcelona. Ports of call, ship and dates have not been given, so none are named. The marker is the port of Barcelona.

destinations.name: Three-Night Cruise
destinations.blurb: Three nights at sea, setting sail from Southampton. The pin marks the port we left from.
destinations._source: Confirmed by the crew: a three-night cruise departing from Southampton. Ship, route and dates have not been given, so none are named. The marker is the port of Southampton.
